#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge, section "updates". Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the plugin: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy the folder next to this one and translate the files inside; the plugin reads whatever folders it finds, and a section may be added as a new file without touching the others.
upd.badKey: Nexus rejected the key (HTTP %(code)d) - the sweep stopped: with a bad key every further request would fail the same way
upd.current: the downloaded file is the newest in its section
upd.downloadedNotInstalled: a fresh file from %(theirs)s is already in downloads, but the mod was built from an archive dated %(mine)s
upd.hotfix: the Update section holds a hotfix for your version that was not downloaded
upd.networkDown: the connection to Nexus broke: %(fails)d failures in a row, the last one %(error)s; the sweep stopped
upd.newer: the page holds a newer file of the same role
upd.noApiKey: no Nexus API key in the Windows credential store - MO2 is not connected to Nexus (Settings - Nexus - Connect)
upd.noDomain: no Nexus section known for the game %(game)s - MO2 did not name one; add a mapping to nexusDomains in the settings, or there is nobody to ask
upd.noNexusId: the mod has no nexusId - it is not linked to Nexus
upd.otherRole: the main file is in place, but Main gained a newer file of another role
upd.quotaLow: the Nexus daily allowance is running out (%(left)s left) - the sweep stopped so the key keeps working for MO2 itself
upd.rateLimited: the Nexus request limit is used up, retry in %(retry)s - the sweep stopped, since each further attempt would only extend the block
upd.renamed: your file is in Old files and Main holds a newer one under another name
upd.replaced: your file is no longer on the page - the author replaced it; downloaded %(mine)s, Main now holds a file from %(theirs)s
upd.retired: the downloaded file moved to Old files and nothing of the same name replaced it
upd.timeout: Nexus did not answer within %(sec).0f s
upd.unmarked: no file on the page is marked as downloaded
